results.title: Will Jensen Huang return?
results.description: Just like a Marvel Cinematic Universe end-credit teaser, there are some whispers and rumors going around about former NVIDIA CEO’s Jensen Huang’s possible return after his much-publicized resignation last week over allegations of extramarital affairs. One of these affairs was with a suspected Chinese spy. Yup, it's just like it came from a movie. Nvidia‘s stock price saw an increase after going down following Jensen Huang's statement on Tuesday, which was posted on X. He’d be “honored” to return as CEO should the company’s board of directors ask him to, his first public statement following his resignation last week. “Since my departure, I’ve seen an outpouring of calls from Nvidia’s employees, investors, business partners, and customers for me to return as CEO,” he wrote in a statement. “Many continue to reach out to me directly as the company navigates complex technology, market, competitive, and geopolitical dynamics. Nvidia is a once-in-a-generation company. If the Board of Directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO.” Employees also called for Huang to be reinstated as CEO last week. Although Jensen might want to pump the brakes on moving back into his office, NVIDIA board chair Harvey Jones said that the company does not intend to reinstate him as chief executive at the start of its earnings call. Aiming to reassure investors, interim CEO Colette Kress emphasized that Nvidia’s “roadmap is on track, and our ambition has never been greater.” Just like waiting for the next film in the MCU, we’d have to wait and see if Huang will indeed return to take the helm at NVIDIA. Who knows? Maybe a cameo?
